name: Wisconsin

rule.hpNote: any motorboat (no hp threshold), PWC included
rule.textEn: Anyone born on or after Jan. 1, 1989 needs a Wisconsin (or accepted out-of-state) boating safety certificate to run a motorboat or PWC, unless a qualifying adult is aboard (motorboats only).
rule.textEs: Quien nació el 1 de enero de 1989 o después necesita un certificado de seguridad náutica de Wisconsin (o de otro estado aceptado) para manejar una lancha o moto acuática, salvo que vaya a bordo un adulto que cumpla los requisitos (solo lanchas).

minAge.note: Motorboats: none under 10; ages 10-11 only with a qualifying parent/guardian/designated adult; ages 12-15 with such an adult or a certificate. PWC: none under 12; from 12 with a certificate, adult supervision does not replace it.

exemptions: Motorboat operators 16+ accompanied by someone 18+ who holds a certificate or was born before 1989 (not for PWC).

card.feeNote: DNR classroom course $10; internet courses about $50.95-$60.95. Duplicates can be printed free from a Go Wild account.

rental: Renters 16+ from a licensed rental agent can use a boat rental education certificate valid until the end of that calendar year; no PWC rental under 16.
pwcExtra: PWC from 12 only with a certificate; an adult on board does not replace it. No PWC rental under 16.

sources.quote: Wisconsin boating safety certification or out-of-state equivalent certification is required for operators born on or after Jan. 1, 1989.
A person younger than 10 years may not operate a motorboat
A person 12-15 years old may operate a motorboat only if:
They are accompanied by another person in the motorboat who is at least 18 years of age AND that person holds a valid boating safety certificate or was born before Jan. 1, 1989.
There are no age requirements for operating a boat that is not equipped with a motor.
No one under the age of 12 may operate, lease or rent a personal watercraft.
No one under the age of 16 may rent or lease a personal watercraft.
Adult supervision is not a substitute for a certificate.
The certificate is valid until the end of the calendar year in which it is issued.
$10 for a traditional classroom. $50.95 - $60.95 for internet courses.
Boat operators now have convenient online methods to receive boat safety certification through internet courses.
